craft_notes: Sthāyin: crown-entry (blaze enters — v37's tilak returns as arrival). Rows: row 2 (all→enters). Close: enters (samāviśet — entry-verb, echoes v24-25 entry-language). Rejected: 'kundalini reaches crown' — killed: sky-all-as-Bhairava kept (contemplation, not kundalinī); splitting the blaze-name — killed: Bhairava-form-blaze-reality is one word of the text (bhairavākāratejastattva).

lines: Crown dissolved, sky all as Bhairava:
l4.sanskrit_cite: līnaṃ mūrdhni viyat sarvam bhairavatvena bhāvayet | tat sarvam bhairavākāratejastattvaṃ samāviśet

reads_against.argmap: What enters when sky is all Bhairava? → Contemplating all-sky as Bhairava, the blaze-reality enters.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with adbhuta (stillness startled by its own gates)
